name: Suva
summary: Suva, the capital of Fiji, is the most affordable gateway to the South Pacific: low cost of living, English as the official language and beaches like Nasese within walking distance of the centre. It is more of an administrative and port capital than a postcard destination - that's what Nadi or the outer islands are for - but it already has a real coworking (Greenhouse Coworking). The internet is far behind other nomadic hubs and security drops significantly at night, something to keep in mind when choosing accommodation.
